ambient_events: A gull and a pigeon dispute a chip wrapper on the steps.
Wind off the bay carries the smell of salt and diesel up the stair.
description: A broad municipal stair that once led somewhere that mattered. Now it just connects the records office to the water, and the pigeons have claimed the landings.

flags.intro_lore: These steps used to mean the city cared what happened to you — records, hearings, a stamp that said you existed. The office behind them still runs, after a fashion, but it works for whoever pays it now. Watch the landings. What looks like pigeons is sometimes lookouts, and the water at the bottom keeps its own secrets.

name: Civic Steps
